title: Don't suppress nullable warnings with `!` as a default habit
symptoms: NullReferenceException at runtime in config-binding or EF entity code
explanation: With <Nullable>enable</Nullable>, CS8600/CS8602/CS8618 are real signals — especially in EF Core entities and config-binding models where a field can legitimately be null after deserialization. Handle the null instead of suppressing with `!`.
